How can we derive a ∈ s from a ∈ OrderDual.toDual s, where a : A and s : Set A?
(cc @Jovan Gerbscheid)
The statement is already abusing defeq: a ∈ OrderDual.toDual s should not make sense for a : A.
Note that it is not (s : Set (OrderDual A)), it is (s : OrderDual (Set A)).
Yes, s : OrderDual (Set A) has no elements a priori

Whenever something holds trivially by abusing defeq, the answer to the question of how to avoid defeq is to make a lemma that is proved by using that defeq, and after that you can use that lemma instead of abusing the defeq
